# Radio ePlus

> Radio ePlus is an internet radio directory for discovering and listening to live radio stations from countries around the world.

## Canonical site

- https://radio.eplus.dev/

## Discovery

- Sitemap: https://radio.eplus.dev/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://radio.eplus.dev/robots.txt
- Agent guide: https://radio.eplus.dev/agents.md

## Site structure

- /`area` — browse countries in a region
- /`area`/`country` — browse radio stations in a country
- /`area`/`country`/`station` — listen to a specific station

Station pages may include live program, track, schedule, and lyric data when available.
